label: lem:charpoly-roots-root-of-unity
title: Charpoly roots of a finite-order endomorphism are $n$-th roots of unity
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{C}$ and let $f : V \to_{\ell} V$ with $f^n = \mathrm{id}_V$ for some $n \geq 1$.  Then every $\lambda \in f.\mathrm{charpoly}.\mathrm{roots}$ satisfies $\lambda^n = 1$.
proof: Combine Lemma~\ref{lem:charpoly-roots-are-eigenvalues} (the root is an eigenvalue) with Lemma~\ref{lem:eig-root-of-unity} ($n$-th power of an eigenvalue is $1$).
